title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps separate the grey, blue and black circles mostly by colour; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette and line styles that stay distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`, `sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Circles distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: growth-aware advection
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. The shipped nowcast reaches CSI 0.38 at 60 minutes on the GROWTH scene; the milestone asks for 0.6.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: advect along a curved path
body:
## Problem
Session 3 shows that straight-line advection fails for a rotating pattern (CSI 0.08 at 60 minutes).

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A lesson, checkpoint and app that advect in sub-steps and reach a CSI of 0.5 on the rotating-ring scene.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint met and tested
- [ ] Short write-up of the method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Reproduce the Target: local flow with growth
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows local optical flow with a growth trend; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CSI of at least 0.6 at 60 minutes on the GROWTH scene
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add a sharper interpolation (cubic) to Session 2
body:
## Problem
Bilinear interpolation blurs the field (peak 0.973 after a half-pixel shift of a sigma = 3 cell).

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3 asks for a scheme that keeps the peak.

## Expected outcome
A cubic-interpolation shift function with a checkpoint that compares its blur with the bilinear one.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-02/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Mass conservation checked
- [ ] Blur smaller than bilinear at half a pixel

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
